verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply this week; intake and tracking gaps are being fixed.
narrative: This period, you received 7 tracked leads on $1,695 in total ad spend, with the last 7 days seeing an 80% drop in leads compared to the prior 7 days — driving cost per lead up to $242. The root cause is not ad performance: Meta delivered 615 clicks on $754 in spend, but lead tracking shows a clear intake or attribution gap that is being repaired now. Separately, lead response routing is being confirmed and corrected following a staffing change, so incoming leads are not falling through. Heating campaign creative and Local Services Ads are on track to go live by October 1, which is when volume should begin recovering. Google Business Profile engagement remains healthy, with 30 calls and 75 direction requests this period driven primarily by your Quality HVAC Solutions profile.
